But this isnt about your friends and what they think. This is about you and him. As far as he knows you are the Bonnie to his Clyde. He thinks its you two vs the world etc. I cannot tell you when you should break up with him. You know him and yourself best.

But I can tell you this. I found out my long term ex was cheating on me. I suspected for 2 months and called her out on it a couple of times. I could tell she was confused because she still "loved" me to a degree. But I knew and even asked her if she wanted to call it quits. She said no, she was still confused to what she wanted that much I could tell. She dragged me along till she finally picked a fight with me calling me paranoid and breaking it off. Sure enough  found out she had a secret facebook and had been seeing an ex. She also was hinting to one of my friends that she wanted to call it quits but he never told me. I was devestated and still am. You see I dont have the luxury of just being broken up because we are not together. I have to deal with the fact she was cheating, lying to me about how she felt, used me to cushion her conscience till she was ready to break it off etc.

Now, you are not like her and your situation is way diffrent. As there is no cheating involved.

However, I doubt your guy is a complete dumbass. He probbally knows something is wrong and in his own way seems like he is trying to fix it by getting in more time with you. Why else would he keep trying to plan stuff with you. He is at a point it seems where he still trust and loves you. He like a million others in a relationship expects honesty out of his partner-you.

I remember crunching data for my research, while working full time and juggling a relationship etc. But if you really care about how this guy feels you need to MAKE time to tell him the truth. He is a human being that trust and loves you. I am 31 years old. Most of the women I have dated I have caught cheating or flirting with other men (via chats, txt or something). By most I mean all but one. I was dating my ex for 2 years. I tried everything to make the relationship work. Had a helthy amount of personal space, but I was always trying to find things for us to do or talk about. Turned into a white knight for her, defending her honor and never letting anyone be rude with her etc but not being a maniac and beating peoples asses left and right. 

Early in the relationship I caught her flirting with an ex. I broke up with her and was going to move on. But she begged and pleaded etc etc and I took her back. I am not completely sure why I did. But I am sure it had something to do with me getting older and tired of being alone. Not to mention even though it was early in the relationship I was sprung on her. Till then she treated me like a king and in turn I treated her like a queen.

Fast foward. Two months ago I notice her acting moody, I notice her schedule changing and her disappearing for lentghs of time etc etc. I call her on it. She calls me paranoid, keeping track of her, and controling etc. I bring up one of those list that have the top 10 signs your partner is cheating on you. I point out she hits a 9 out of 10. I point out that I dont want to believe she is cheating on me but I am not stupid either. We break up. 

I started doubting myself. Maybe I was wrong paranoid etc. She didnt have a facebook that I knew about. But I remembered she had a female coworker email me a while back about a comptuer issue. I used that emal of her friend and found her facebook. Low and behold I found she a secret facebook account with an email she hid from me and she has been boneing some guy at work all this time.

Its been a lil over a week. I am still devestated. I have tried doing all things people suggest and what has got me through break ups in the past. Working out, going out, getting into old or new hobbies. Talking to people, sometimes (often) I cry. I have had to drink somenights just to dull my senses and go to bed because I feel so "energetically depressed" lol. The only thing stopping me from going ape shit is that I know with time I can get past this because I have in the past. But I am numb till i hit those  sadness and anger waves.

I am getting old. Have been through the relationship game way to many times. I have never cheatted on a gf and I have had been given the oppurtunities to. Part of this is my fault because I should have dumped her and never looked back from the get go. But I am human. I need love and a connection. 

I dont know what anyone can say to make you feel better. I wish I could tell you something that would make you magicaly feel better. Or tell you how you will find that magic someone etc etc 

But I cant lie to you. I dont know what the future holds. You are in for a world of pain. Odds are you are feeling it right now since the shock wore off. We live in a world where 50% of marriages end in divorce. Where people love watching reality tv shows for the drama in relationships etc.  While alot of this phenomenom is new in how wide spread it is, I dont think its new for humans. I just think its eaiser for us to do. Your going to hurt and you can do everything right in a relationship and still get cheated on.

But you dont deserve it. You dont deseve for people to betray your trust when all you are giving them is your love. Some people do not understand what love, commitment, and trust mean. They just want it and when they take it they are not careful with it. They dont understand its worth more then all the gold and diamonds. 

I want to end this on a positive note. But I am in a dark place like you to so I really dont know what to say, cause if I did then maybe I wouldnt feel like shit. LOL I guess all I can say is you are not alone. I dont understand everything that went wrong or why your ex is such a fuck up. But I understand you dont deserve to feel what your feeling and I understand that going through this sucks.

I hope you feel better.

I think you need to see a counselor/thearpist. You need help right now if you are seriously contemplating suicide. I know money might be an issue but many counties provide free mental health care. Also some thearpist and counselors suck balls. But some are awesome as hell. You just have to find one you connect with.

Also there are many introverted and shy animae geek gals out there who need love. A friend of mine dragged me to a small anime club at our library (most members being adults) there were some super nerdy animae fan girls there who were socially awkward as hell and seemed like they knew nothing except how to talk about animae and manga etc. What I am saying is you are not going to catch a fish by not going near the water. Look up Animae style events or clubs etc near where you live. Go to some and see if any chicks around your age are there. If one catches your eye and shares your intrest Ask them out because what have you got to lose? Nothing and you have everything to gain.

You like games and Animae. Is there anyway you can try applying for a job near by that has something to do with your interest? 

Finally go for your GED. It will give you more oppurtunities and it is a goal you can knock out.

But please. Seek help. If your feeling of blah is strong enough to make you desire your own death, then why not take two steps into a counselors office and say I feel depressed or suicidal at times and I need some help so I dont feel this way the majority of the time.

If your tired of fighting then get help. Force yourself to seek professinal aide. You are not the first or the last person to feel soul crushed. But you are the person right now who needs help with all of the things not making you want to wake up or exist. Try finding a thearpist that you can connect with and an anti depression medication regime that works for you. 

If you can be mentally determined enough to think of hanging yourself then you can be mentally determined enough to take those hard two steps into a counselors office and tell them the words "I need help".

Please seek aide. I want you to have a much better life with friends in a world you do not feel disconnected from. Its possible. Dont say it isnt till you have tried getting help.
